title: Of Light and Heat Obstructa
description: Of Light and Heat Obstructa — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Taxman Jones

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 10 Ice Mutant Twins and 10 Shadow Fade Hatchlings on Frump's Misfortune Levels 6 and 7.

Quest Reward: 7500 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Taxman Jones

Repeatable: No

Tip: An easy quest, just work your way through the levels and the monsters will fall to you.
